purpose: Ground-truth geometry for Ball Barrage's mounted hazard pieces (not walkable surfaces, so not raycast-scanned; see course-sockets-ballbarrage.json for that methodology). For any single BasePart, Size defines a box always centered exactly on CFrame (Roblox engine guarantee), so Support (base contact, local space) = (0, -Size.Y/2, 0) with no measurement needed. What is NOT derivable from Size/CFrame alone is the parent-to-child relative transform for two-mesh assemblies, so that was read directly via parent.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(child.CFrame) in Studio Edit mode against the untouched workspace.battle_stadium.
note: PivotOffset (the 'PΔ' column in 01-asset-inventory.md) is a separate, artist-authored property independent of Size/CFrame; it becomes irrelevant once CourseBuilder clears it per HANDOFF 5.1 step 2, so it is not used in any socket below.

Support.note: pole bottom face, relative to pole's own CFrame

BigBall_obstacle_23_001.note: Sphere embeds ~2.1 studs into pole top; BigBall=true goes on the sphere only, pole is support geometry per HANDOFF 6.

spring_obstacle_22_002.relPosToBase: not independently read (spring is a slide child, not a rock/rotate child); use inventory.json size 5.95x5.66x21.90

axle.note: pillar's own CFrame origin is the mechanical axle; head hangs 16.85 studs below it and rocks about this point per HANDOFF 6 'head 002 pivot at pillar axle'

Support.note: pillar bottom; pillar itself is the fixed mount, not the moving part

JumpPad_trampoline_1_001.note: trampoline_1_002 renamed to the Inner role, trampoline_1_001 to Outer, matching the trampoline_3 JumpPad precedent (01-asset-inventory.md line 214). trampoline_1 has no existing course usage, so this is the first renaming for it.
